acc-rate-area.alt: Graph of the rate r(t) at which water flows into a tank, in liters per minute, for t from 0 to 12 minutes. The region above the t-axis from 0 to 8 has area 34 (34 liters flow in); the region below the axis from 8 to 12 has area 9 (9 liters drain out). The net change is 25 liters.
